source_statement: Let ABCDEF be a convex equilateral hexagon such that lines BC, AD, and EF are parallel. Let H be the orthocenter of triangle ABD. If the smallest interior angle of the hexagon is 4 degrees, determine the smallest angle of the triangle HAD in degrees.
